topic.description: 追踪冲突、军备、公共安全和仍在发展的重大事件

items.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
items.summary: Iran says the attack on Larak Island, the first known US strikes since late July, killed two people and injured two others.

items.summaryZh: 伊朗表示，美国对拉拉克岛发动的袭击是自7月下旬以来的首次已知行动。此次袭击造成两人死亡，另有两人受伤。
items.whyImportant: 美伊之间军事冲突的升级加剧了中东地区的紧张局势。

items.title: Australia news live: NSW won’t appeal ruling that found anti-Israel vandalism was not antisemitic; body of newborn baby found in bin in Sydney
items.summary: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The Australian government is working with Russian officials in a bid to secure the release of Australian Oscar Jenkins, Matt Thistlethwaite says. Speaking to ABC news breakfast, the assistant minister for foreign affairs declined to answer whether a prisoner swap was on the table. Obviously, we try and negotiate as best we can on behalf of all Australians who find themselves in difficulties such as this. We obviously have to abide by international laws and we always uphold them. But the Australian officials on the ground will work with their counterparts to ensure that, hopefully he’s returned to Australia safely. Continue reading...

items.whyImportant: 此事件涉及澳大利亚公民的海外安全及政府的外交斡旋能力。

items.title: Man who murdered Molly Ticehurst will not face life in jail, judge says
items.summary: Justice Natalie Adams says she is troubled by expert evidence about rape allegations in slain woman’s police statement Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Molly Ticehurst’s ex-boyfriend will not face a life sentence for her domestic violence murder, a crime which galvanised a national movement against gendered abuse. Ticehurst, a 28-year-old childcare educator, was found dead in her home at Forbes, in the New South Wales central-west, in the early hours of 22 April 2024. Continue reading...

items.summaryZh: 法官娜塔莉·亚当斯对受害者警方陈述中关于强奸指控的专家证据表示担忧。这起引发全国反性别暴力运动的谋杀案被告将不会面临终身监禁。
items.whyImportant: 该判决结果引发了公众对于家庭暴力案件量刑标准的广泛讨论。

items.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部表示，美军轰炸了拉拉克岛上的两个伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队火箭发射器，称其构成了“迫在眉睫的威胁”。
items.whyImportant: 美伊军事对抗范围的扩大可能导致地区安全局势进一步恶化。

items.titleZh: 中尼洪水、日本向印度部署战斗机：你错过的5篇周末阅读
items.summaryZh: 本文汇总了近期亚洲及全球的重要新闻，包括日本计划首次向印度部署战斗机。专家认为此举旨在加强印太地区“志同道合”国家间的安全合作。
items.whyImportant: 日本的军事部署调整反映了印太地区安全格局的复杂变化。

items.title: NHS to offer free high-street cholesterol tests in England
items.summary: Checks at pharmacies for people aged 40 to 84 are aimed at identifying those at risk of heart attack or stroke The NHS in England is to offer free finger-prick blood tests for cholesterol on the high street for the first time under plans to reduce heart disease and stroke deaths by a quarter within the next decade. The seven-minute tests will be available at participating pharmacies as part of a national rollout to spot “ticking timebombs” earlier. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）将在英格兰提供免费街头胆固醇检测
items.summaryZh: 英格兰的药店将为40至84岁的人群提供免费指尖采血胆固醇检测。此举旨在及早发现健康风险，以期在未来十年内将心脏病和中风死亡率降低四分之一。
items.whyImportant: 该公共卫生举措旨在通过早期筛查降低心血管疾病的死亡率。

items.title: Pakistani nurse to be honoured for saving newborn from deadly hospital fire
items.summary: A Pakistani nurse who rescued the sole surviving newborn from a hospital nursery fire that killed 14 other infants will receive one of the country’s most prestigious civil awards. Fire engulfed Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, a major government hospital in Islamabad, on Wednesday. A 51-second segment of CCTV footage, widely circulated online, captures Razia Noreen running into the burning nursery and emerging seconds later with the newborn in her arms. She tries to go back in, but cannot...

items.titleZh: 巴基斯坦护士因从致命医院火灾中救出新生儿而获表彰
items.summaryZh: 一名巴基斯坦护士在伊斯兰堡一家医院的火灾中，冒死救出了唯一的幸存新生儿。她将因此获得该国最高级别的平民奖项之一。
items.whyImportant: 此举表彰了在灾难中表现出的英勇行为，并引发了对医院安全标准的关注。

items.summary: Footage shows Israeli military vehicles and personnel deployed across Nablus city in the occupied West Bank.

items.summaryZh: 现场画面显示，以色列军用车辆和人员已部署在被占领的约旦河西岸城市纳布卢斯。目前已有两名巴勒斯坦人在冲突中死亡的报告。
items.whyImportant: 约旦河西岸的持续冲突进一步加剧了巴以之间的紧张关系。

items.titleZh: 美国一个月内首次袭击后，伊朗将目标对准约旦
items.summaryZh: 美国对拉拉克岛的设施发动了近一个月来的首次袭击。作为回应，伊朗对相关基地进行了反击。
items.whyImportant: 美伊双方的报复性打击行动增加了地区冲突失控的风险。

items.title: ‘Everything’s smashed to bits’: Ukrainians turn anger on those storing weapons near their villages
items.summary: As Russia hits another ammunition warehouse, killing at least 38, locals put blame on poorly placed depots It is a day and a half since a Russian jet-powered drone smashed into an ammunition dump in Myla, a village 15 miles outside central Kyiv. Volodymyr, 61, a security guard, leads visitors from his family’s badly damaged home, its roof blown off, back windows shattered, through the garden towards the impact site 300 metres away. The garden, like so many in Ukraine’s villages and suburbs, is a sizeable allotment. But today the greenhouse is shattered, a vegetable patch is blackened and crisp underfoot. Several metres of grapevine have been destroyed. Even so, Volodymyr finds two surviving bunches to hand to the Guardian. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: “一切都被砸得粉碎”：乌克兰民众对在村庄附近储存武器的行为感到愤怒
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯无人机袭击了基辅郊外米拉村的一个弹药库，造成至少38人死亡。当地居民对军方将弹药库设在居民区附近表示强烈不满，认为这种做法导致了平民财产受损和生命威胁。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了乌克兰在战时军事部署与平民安全保护之间面临的严峻矛盾。

items.title: Embattled Sydney property developer Bathla warns it could fold by the end of the week
items.summary: Administrators said it would be forced to close the business if it failed to secure additional funding, revealing hundreds of staff have not been paid for weeks The administrators of embattled property developer Bathla Group have said the company will fold by the end of the week unless they can secure additional funding to keep it afloat. The insolvency advisory Teneo assumed control of Bathla’s operations on 25 August after the Sydney-based construction company went into voluntary administration. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 陷入困境的悉尼房地产开发商Bathla警告称本周末可能倒闭
items.summaryZh: 悉尼建筑公司Bathla Group的破产管理人表示，除非能获得额外资金，否则公司将在本周末被迫关闭。目前该公司已有数百名员工数周未领到工资。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了对当地建筑行业稳定性及员工权益保障的担忧。

items.title: Xi is in Bishkek for SCO summit. How does bloc fit China’s Eurasian strategy 25 years on?
items.summary: As Washington’s strategic focus shifts and energy and grain supply disruptions continue to unsettle the Middle East, Beijing’s expanding presence across Central Asia is expected to be in focus as Kyrgyzstan hosts the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit this week. Chinese President Xi Jinping’s presence in Bishkek is expected to put the spotlight on whether the increasingly diverse grouping can move beyond diplomatic signalling, according to analysts. The SCO’s 25th anniversary summit...
items.titleZh: 习近平出席比什凯克上合组织峰会，该组织如何契合中国25年来的欧亚战略？
items.summaryZh: 随着华盛顿战略重心转移及能源供应波动，北京在欧亚地区的布局备受关注。分析人士指出，此次峰会将聚焦上合组织能否在外交姿态之外，进一步深化区域合作。
items.whyImportant: 此次峰会是观察中国在欧亚地区地缘政治影响力和战略意图的重要窗口。

items.title: Russia, China leaders to meet at Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit
items.summary: The organisation is not officially anti-West, but Russian and Chinese leaders have used it to amplify their worldview.
items.titleZh: 俄中领导人将在上海合作组织峰会上会晤
items.summaryZh: 尽管上合组织并非正式的反西方联盟，但俄罗斯和中国领导人经常利用该平台阐述其世界观。此次峰会预计将进一步加强两国间的战略协调。
items.whyImportant: 俄中领导人的互动对全球地缘政治平衡具有重要影响。

items.title: Backlash grows after Hong Kong authorities seize second ‘fighting dog’ in week
items.summary: Hong Kong authorities are facing a growing backlash after seizing a “fighting dog” from its owner following a neighbour’s complaint and detaining it for behavioural evaluation. It was the second dog with pit bull lineage that the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department had seized in a week. The department’s actions came amid heightened public concern over canine management, following a series of recent attacks, including one in which a woman was mauled and later found dead, and...

items.titleZh: 香港当局一周内查扣第二只“格斗犬”，引发舆论反弹
items.summaryZh: 香港渔农自然护理署因邻居投诉，查扣了一只被认定为“格斗犬”的狗并进行行为评估。这是该部门一周内第二次采取此类行动，引发了公众对犬只管理政策的争议。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了香港社会在公共安全与动物福利之间的舆论分歧。

items.title: ‘A warning saved my life’: can Hongkongers trust smartwatches, or are they being misled?
items.summary: In the third instalment of a five-part Health Matters wellness series on Hong Kong’s growing wellness trends, Victor Ting examines how wearable devices are reshaping personal healthcare in the city, as experts caution that they should not replace professional medical advice. Alice Wong had little idea how seriously ill she might become until unusual patterns on her smartwatch prompted her to seek medical advice. A year ago, Wong, who was still in her twenties, had bought the device but paid...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: “警报救了我一命”：香港人能信任智能手表吗，还是被误导了？
items.summaryZh: 智能穿戴设备在香港健康管理中日益普及，一些用户通过设备监测到了潜在的健康问题。专家提醒，这些设备不能替代专业的医疗诊断，应谨慎对待其数据。
items.whyImportant: 随着可穿戴医疗技术的普及，公众对健康数据的依赖与医疗专业性之间的界限引发关注。

items.title: Ukraine prepares for talks with Trump envoys as Kyiv reels from deadly strikes
items.summary: Ukraine is preparing for a new round of talks with representatives of US President Donald Trump, President Volodymyr Zelensky announced Sunday, expressing hope that diplomacy can prevent open conflict from remaining the only path forward. “There will be more details tomorrow. We will do everything we can so that war does not remain the only option for how events unfold further,” Zelensky said in a televised address. “It is important that America shares many of our views on the situation”. US-led...

items.titleZh: 乌克兰准备与特朗普特使进行会谈，基辅正从致命袭击中恢复
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基宣布，乌方正准备与美国总统特朗普的代表进行新一轮会谈。他表示希望通过外交手段寻求和平，避免战争成为唯一的选择。
items.whyImportant: 乌美双方的接触对于未来乌克兰冲突的走向具有关键意义。

items.title: Venezuela’s Delcy Rodríguez defends ‘endless’ benefits of her oil deal with Trump
items.summary: Deal that will reportedly see US take control of 65bn barrels of Venezuelan oil has provoked outrage in her country Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has defended her government’s highly controversial energy deal with Donald Trump, insisting the South American country will maintain ownership and sovereignty over its massive oil reserves. Rodríguez, who assumed power in January after Trump ordered the abduction of the president, Nicolás Maduro, took to the airwaves on Saturday to push back against criticism of what the US president has called “the biggest oil deal in world history”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 委内瑞拉德尔西·罗德里格斯为她与特朗普达成的“无尽”石油协议辩护
items.summaryZh: 委内瑞拉临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯为该国与特朗普达成的能源协议辩护，坚称委内瑞拉仍拥有其石油储备的主权。该协议因涉及美国控制委内瑞拉650亿桶石油而引发国内强烈抗议。
items.whyImportant: 此协议引发了关于国家主权与能源控制权的重大争议，并加剧了委内瑞拉国内的政治紧张局势。

items.title: Trump ‘border czar’ denies Milo Yiannopoulos was deported quickly to spare him from ICE detention
items.summary: Tom Homan denies British far-right commentator, who was deported one day after arrest, got preferential treatment The White House “border czar,” Tom Homan, denied on Sunday that deporting British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos just a day after being arrested by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) amounted to preferential treatment. Homan said it was his understanding that Yiannopoulos, 41, had overstayed what he believed to be a visitor visa, had not appeared at an immigration hearing and was issued a final order of removal on 22 July. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普“边境沙皇”否认米洛·伊安诺波卢斯被迅速驱逐是为了让他免受移民局拘留
items.summaryZh: 白宫“边境沙皇”汤姆·霍曼否认英国极右翼评论员米洛·伊安诺波卢斯在被捕次日即被驱逐出境是享受了特殊待遇。霍曼表示，伊安诺波卢斯因逾期滞留且未出席移民听证会，已于7月22日被下达最终驱逐令。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对移民执法程序公平性及是否存在政治优待的质疑。

items.title: Canada erects giant ‘Lake Ontario’ sign as spat with Trump over name escalates
items.summary: Meanwhile, Trump posts video of himself kicking over a Lake Ontario sign and replacing it with Lake America sign Donald Trump and Canada continued a verbal duel on Saturday over the US government’s administrative renaming of Lake Ontario, with the Ontario premier erecting a giant sign saying “Lake Ontario. Now and Always” – and the American president posting a video of him tearing down an avatar of that sign, erecting a replacement saying Lake America, and dancing to YMCA. Rhetoric over the naming of Lake Ontario is the public face of an escalating trade dispute between the US and its northern neighbor involving a 50% US tariff on Canadian steel and retaliatory tariffs from Ottawa. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 随着与特朗普关于名称的争端升级，加拿大竖起巨大的“安大略湖”标志
items.summaryZh: 特朗普与加拿大就安大略湖更名问题持续发生口角，特朗普发布视频展示其拆除安大略湖标志并替换为“美国湖”的过程。这一争端是美加两国因钢材关税引发的贸易战的公开表现。
items.whyImportant: 地名争端反映了美加两国在贸易政策上的深层矛盾，进一步加剧了双边外交紧张关系。

items.title: Trump says NBC’s Kristen ‌Welker should face ‘punishment’ from FCC
items.summary: Trump’s threat comes after host described success record of candidates whom president had endorsed as ‘mixed’ Donald Trump ⁠on Sunday said NBC’s Kristen ‌Welker – host of Meet the Press – should face “rebuke or punishment” from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Welker, during a live segment for a local Washington, DC, affiliate, described the success record of political candidates whom the president had endorsed as “mixed”. The segment aired prior to Sunday’s edition of Meet the Press. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普称NBC的克里斯汀·威尔克应受到联邦通信委员会的“惩罚”
items.summaryZh: 特朗普因NBC主持人克里斯汀·威尔克称其背书的候选人表现“好坏参半”，公开要求联邦通信委员会对其进行惩罚。该言论出现在威尔克主持的《会见新闻界》节目播出前的一段直播中。
items.whyImportant: 总统对媒体报道的公开施压引发了关于新闻自由及政府干预媒体监管的讨论。

items.title: Eight killed and 18 missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
items.summary: A passenger ferry capsized and sank off Northern Cyprus Sunday, killing at least eight people and leaving more than a dozen missing, officials and media reports said, as police took the captain and seven crew members into custody. Several rescued passengers told local media a blast had gone off at the bow of the ferry before it rolled over, and said the boat had an insufficient supply of life-vests. The vessel capsized 6.5km (4 miles) off the coast of Cyprus, shortly after leaving a Northern...
items.titleZh: 北塞浦路斯附近一艘渡轮倾覆，造成8人死亡，18人失踪
items.summaryZh: 一艘渡轮在北塞浦路斯海岸附近倾覆，导致至少8人死亡，多人失踪，警方已拘留船长及七名船员。幸存者称船头曾发生爆炸，且船上救生衣数量不足。
items.whyImportant: 这起严重的海上事故暴露了当地航运安全管理的重大漏洞，引发了对公共交通安全标准的关注。

items.titleZh: 伊朗在美军袭击拉拉克岛后攻击约旦境内的美军基地
items.summaryZh: 伊朗对约旦境内的美军基地发动了攻击，这是双方自7月下旬以来首次爆发的暴力冲突。此次袭击是对美国此前打击拉拉克岛行动的回应。
items.whyImportant: 美伊之间军事冲突的升级增加了中东地区局势的不确定性与地缘政治风险。

items.title: Trump calls for ‘punishment’ of NBC journalist over endorsement coverage
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Sunday threatened a prominent NBC broadcast journalist with possible punishment by US media regulators as the Republican expressed disappointment with coverage of his candidate endorsements ahead of November’s midterm elections. Trump took to his Truth Social platform to attack Kristen Welker as the “unpopular ‘hostess’ of the once great Meet the Press” talk show. He objected to her having said the president had had “mixed results” on his endorsement of political...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 特朗普因背书报道要求“惩罚”NBC记者
items.summaryZh: 特朗普威胁要让媒体监管机构惩罚NBC记者克里斯汀·威尔克，因其在报道中称特朗普背书的候选人表现“好坏参半”。特朗普在社交平台上对该记者的报道表示不满。
items.whyImportant: 总统针对特定记者的言论再次引发了关于政治权力与媒体监督边界的争议。
